claims.text: Across the March v1.3 release candidates, NVIDIA’s TensorRT-LLM release notes document additions spanning FLUX pipelines, B300 VLM support, dynamic KV-cache quota resizing, KVCache v2/MTP work, Python KV transceivers, Qwen3.5 NVFP4 support, request priority, reusable KV blocks, FlexKV, prefix-affinity routing, and MoE-serving changes.
claims.context: Official GitHub release notes across the grouped release-candidate series; performance and compatibility effects remain project-reported.

limitations.text: These are pre-release v1.3 release candidates rather than a stable v1.3 release; release-note performance and compatibility claims are not independently benchmarked here, and the separate stable v1.2.0 task must not be conflated with this series.
